data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reported a prior year reserve release of GBP 45.34 million in 2024. This favorable development was primarily driven by good experience on its longer tail and specialty classes for the 2021 and 2022 underwriting years. The report also notes that consideration was made for the 2022 year of account reinsurance to close regarding multi-year exposure to the devastating wildfires in Los Angeles in January 2025, an event expected to trigger material losses.
